_meta.title: On This Day — biblical-history seed set
_meta.status: SEED — small, accurate starter set. EXPAND + GATE before launch.
_meta.rule: Only events with an explicit Scriptural date anchor (a stated biblical month + day). No fabricated or harmonised dates. Month/day are the biblical (Hebrew) month index (1 = Abib/Nisan) and day-of-month, which recur each year.
_meta.todo: Candidates to add once verified: Shavuot (count-derived, not fixed-date), Ezekiel's temple vision (Ezek 40:1), Solomon's temple foundation (1 Kgs 6:1 — month given, day not), dedication of the second temple (Ezra 6:15, Adar 3).

events.title: The Tabernacle is raised
events.summary: On the first day of the first month the Dwelling Place was set up — God comes to dwell among His people.

events.title: The waters of the Flood are dried up
events.summary: On the first day of the first month the waters were dried from off the earth, and Noah removed the covering of the ark.

events.title: The Passover lamb is set apart
events.summary: On the tenth of the first month each household took a lamb, kept up until the fourteenth — the lamb chosen four days before it was slain.

events.title: Passover
events.summary: The lamb is slain between the evenings on the fourteenth of the first month — the blood on the doorposts, the LORD's Passover.

events.title: Unleavened Bread / the Exodus from Egypt
events.summary: On the fifteenth of the first month Israel went out from Rameses with a high hand, the day after the Passover — the Feast of Unleavened Bread begins.

events.title: Wave Sheaf — and the manna ceases in Canaan
events.summary: The firstfruits sheaf is waved; in Joshua's day the manna ceased the morrow after the Passover, when Israel ate the old grain of the land.

events.title: The Flood begins
events.summary: On the seventeenth day of the second month all the fountains of the great deep were broken up and the windows of heaven were opened.

events.title: The earth is fully dry after the Flood
events.summary: On the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was dry, and God commanded Noah to go forth from the ark.

events.title: The wall of Jerusalem is finished
events.summary: The wall was completed on the twenty-fifth of Elul, in fifty-two days — the nations saw that the work was wrought of God.

events.title: The Day of Trumpets (Yom Teruah)
events.summary: On the first of the seventh month, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation — a sabbath-rest.

events.title: The Day of Atonement (Yom Kippur)
events.summary: On the tenth of the seventh month you shall afflict your souls — the one day of the year the high priest entered the Most Holy Place.

events.title: The Feast of Tabernacles (Sukkot)
events.summary: On the fifteenth of the seventh month, the Feast of Booths for seven days — Israel dwells in tents, remembering the wilderness.

events.title: The ark rests on the mountains of Ararat
events.summary: On the seventeenth day of the seventh month the ark came to rest — the same biblical date as the later resurrection-season firstfruits.

events.title: The Eighth Day (Shemini Atzeret)
events.summary: On the eighth day a holy convocation and a solemn assembly — the great day that crowns the autumn feasts.

events.title: Haggai's word: 'From this day I will bless you'
events.summary: On the twenty-fourth of the ninth month, the day the temple's foundation was considered, the LORD promised blessing from that day forward.

events.title: The tops of the mountains are seen
events.summary: On the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible as the Flood waters continued to abate.
